questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a pedestrian crossing ahead. Watch for people crossing the road. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
There are a series of curves ahead.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: There are a series of curves ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead has three or more curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Don't park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign means right turns are prohibited.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.
Come to a complete stop before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: If you see this sign, you are going the wrong way on a one-way street. You risk a head-on collision. Turn around carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow backgrounds. This sign warns that a divided highway is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: All traffic must go straight ahead.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of an intersection ahead where a road joins from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers what they must do. This sign means right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers to stay in the right lane to avoid a hazard ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must travel at the speed indicated.
The maximum legal speed on the roadway is 55 mph.
You must travel through the intersection at the posted speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum legal speed on the roadway is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This is a speed limit sign. It shows the highest legal speed allowed on this road. In bad weather or poor conditions, you should drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that deer cross the road in this area. Slow down, stay alert, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This lane is only for left turns from either direction. You cannot use it to pass other cars or drive straight.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It tells you not to drive in your current direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must drive slowly and honk your horn.
You are entering a school parking lot.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you a school zone is coming. Slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep downhill section is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means the road ahead curves to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means it is not safe to enter the road or driveway from your direction. Turn around and find another route.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are entering a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
Left turns on green must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Left turns on green must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign works with a traffic signal. It tells left-turning drivers to wait for oncoming traffic to clear before turning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are allowed on the bridge ahead.
The bridge ahead is one-way traffic only.
The bridge ahead fits only one car at a time.
The bridge may be too narrow to pass a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge may be too narrow to pass a truck.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you the bridge ahead may be too narrow to safely pass a truck. Be careful and slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop completely and look for pedestrians and cross traffic.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and look for pedestrians and cross traffic.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign is a stop sign. Stop completely, check for people walking and other traffic, and wait for the intersection to clear before going.

options.text: The safe speed limit for a residential area.
The safe speed limit for an expressway exit.
The safe speed limit for an expressway entrance.
The safe speed limit for a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The safe speed limit for an expressway exit.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the safe speed for a highway exit. In this example, the speed is 30 mph.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that an intersection is coming. Watch for traffic crossing your path.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a sharp right turn is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The group will exit at the next exit.

questions.explanation: When a lead rider raises their left arm and points their index finger, it means all riders should form a single-file line. This is a hand signal used when riding in groups.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign alerts you that a traffic signal is ahead. Be ready for red lights, yellow lights, and cross traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black markings. They warn you about hazards or special road conditions ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign tells you the road becomes slippery when wet. Drive carefully because your vehicle may be harder to control.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A group is picking up trash along the road ahead.
Workers are on or near the road in the work zone ahead.
There is a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or near the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that workers may be on or near the roadway ahead. Drive carefully through the work zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign alerts you that traffic is coming from the opposite direction.
